description: This file defines a class InMemoryCalendarAccountRepository which serves as a test double for the CalendarAccountRepository. It replaces database-backed account queries with in-memory storage, allowing tests to simulate calendar account retrieval without relying on external database access.

classes.name: InMemoryCalendarAccountRepository
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of CalendarAccountRepository used for testing purposes, supporting account addition, retrieval, and clearing of stored accounts.

methods.name: addAccount
methods.description: Adds a CalendarAccount object to the in-memory store after validating its ID.

methods.name: getCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves calendar accounts matching specified filters such as user ID, account type, validation status, and result limit.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored accounts from the in-memory repository.
